name: Gulfstream G200 / Galaxy
summary: IAI's super-midsize Galaxy, marketed by Gulfstream as the G200 and later succeeded by the G280.

wings: Low swept wing with small upturned winglets
engines: Two Pratt & Whitney Canada PW306A turbofans in pods on the rear fuselage
fuselage: Wide, round-ish fuselage with a row of oval windows

tellTales: Wide-bodied, rounded fuselage with a row of oval windows
T-tail with winglets on a mid-size twinjet
Short, thick tail cone behind the engines

confusedWith.howToTell: The G280 is longer with taller, more prominent winglets; the G200 has smaller winglets and a shorter fuselage.
The Challenger 300 has a longer tapering tail cone and rounded-rectangle windows; the G200 has oval windows and a short, thick tail cone.
The G150 is smaller and narrower with a shorter fuselage; the G200 is bigger with a wider cabin.
The Falcon 2000 has a cruciform tail with the stabilizer partway up the fin; the G200 has a true T-tail.
